364.trigger: Durante a conversa, observam-se flutuações emocionais, fala tensa, expressão ansiosa ou mudanças na velocidade e na expressão, ou há informações a serem relatadas por ele.

373.skill_name: Registrar chief complaint, course of illness, and functional impairment
373.skill_description: Registrar detalhadamente os sintomas e a duração, as situações de gatilho e as razões para buscar ajuda relacionadas às preocupações atuais, bem como o impacto no sono, aprendizado e funções diárias, incluindo informações de atendimento médico quando necessário, como linha de base do problema e para avaliação da gravidade.
373.when_to_use: Na fase de avaliação inicial, para definir a natureza e a gravidade do problema, e antes de estabelecer metas.
373.trigger: O paciente relata medo, ansiedade ou sintomas somáticos, descreve a duração ou menciona exames e resultados hospitalares, e descreve evitação e prejuízo funcional.

390.skill_name: Guiar o preenchimento do formulário de registro de consulta e explicar o processo e as regras
390.skill_description: Guiar o paciente a preencher o formulário de registro de consulta, registrar informações demográficas e de busca de ajuda de forma padronizada, apresentar os procedimentos e regras do processo de consulta, ler e confirmar o acordo de consulta e as exceções à confidencialidade, verificar omissões e itens não claros, garantir que os dados estejam completos, precisos e com consentimento informado.
390.when_to_use: Durante a fase de avaliação diagnóstica e registro inicial da primeira consulta, ao começar a coletar sistematicamente as informações.
390.trigger: O paciente ainda não forneceu dados estruturados ou não está claro sobre o processo e as regras da consulta, é necessário registrar as informações básicas e confirmar o acordo.

343.skill_name: Implement and record psychological test results
343.skill_description: Administer and record key scores and factors from scales such as SCL-90, EPQ, SAS, or SDS with the participant's consent, quantify symptom intensity and range, establish an assessment baseline for assisting diagnosis and follow-up comparison, and can provide preliminary analysis feedback to the participant.
343.when_to_use: During the initial diagnosis or re-evaluation phase, when quantifying symptoms and establishing a baseline is required after a clinical interview.
343.trigger: Participant's consent to undergo psychological testing, or when objective assessment of symptoms such as compulsion, anxiety, etc., and subsequent comparison is needed.

435.skill_name: Collect medication history and family psychiatric history
435.skill_description: Fill in past treatment and therapy experiences (e.g., specific diagnosis of phobia), medication use, and reasons for discontinuation due to side effects, and record family psychiatric history (e.g., no family history of mental illness), to assess risk and feasibility, support diagnosis, and plan treatment.
435.when_to_use: When filling in history items on the initial diagnosis questionnaire, or when conducting a safety assessment before developing an intervention plan.
435.trigger: Participant mentions past medical treatment, medication intolerance, or is asked about family mental illness history.

375.skill_name: Verify and supplement history and family history with relatives and classmates
375.skill_description: Verify and record past physical medical history, personal development history, and family psychiatric history through relatives or classmates to form multi-source data, improve information accuracy and completeness, and avoid bias from a single source.
375.when_to_use: When self-reported information needs verification or supplementation, especially in aspects involving key medical history and family history.
375.trigger: Participant information is limited or there are questions, requiring third-party corroboration and supplementation.

385.skill_name: Coordinate physical examination and record conclusions to rule out organic causes
385.skill_description: Suggest and coordinate medical examinations based on assessment needs, record examination conclusions (e.g., no obvious organic disease) in the record, to rule out organic mental disorders and complete diagnostic evidence, avoiding misjudgment.
385.when_to_use: During the assessment and diagnosis phase, when ruling out organic causes or completing diagnostic evidence is necessary.
385.trigger: Participant has recurrent physical symptoms or concerns about organic issues.

376.skill_name: Review physical examination records and record exclusion conclusions
376.skill_description: Review past physical examinations and relevant test results and record conclusions (e.g., no physical disease found), or note normal/abnormal physical examination, to support psychological diagnosis, differential diagnosis, and guide subsequent intervention.
376.when_to_use: In the initial assessment to differentiate between psychological and physical causes, make a preliminary diagnosis, or decide on the subsequent intervention path.
376.trigger: Past history mentions a physical examination, or suspicion that physical factors may affect current symptoms.

291.skill_description: Select scales such as SCL-90, SAS, SDS, and EPQ for assessment, record total scores and dimension scores according to validity and standards, quantify anxiety, depression, and related factor levels, save as data source for assessment baseline and follow-up comparison.
291.when_to_use: During the initial assessment or diagnostic phase, when quantifying symptoms and establishing a test baseline is required.
291.trigger: Test results have been issued and are valid, or there is a chief complaint of anxiety/depression and standardized scale assessment is needed for related issues.
